overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines only differ in the mime parameter's type (Blob vs Text); the parameter table lists both types on a single 'mime' row, so this is one overload with a multi-type parameter, not two overloads.

params.name: mime
params.description: Email in MIME; pass a BLOB (recommended when the MIME comes from a file, to avoid charset/line-break issues) or Text.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Parses a MIME document (from a BLOB or Text) into a valid email object, following the JMAP specification.

constraints: Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): Mail message building: MAIL New attachment creates attachment objects to add into an Email object's attachments collection -> MAIL Convert to MIME serializes the completed email object to MIME text (used internally by SMTP_transporter.send()) -> MAIL Convert from MIME parses an inbound MIME document back into an email object.
